data: Microsoft reported diluted earnings per share of $9.68 for fiscal 2023 (year ended June 30, 2023), up from $9.65 in fiscal 2022, an increase of about 0.3%. The per-share gain came despite net income slipping slightly to $72,361 million in fiscal 2023 from $72,738 million in fiscal 2022. The difference is explained by a lower diluted share count, which fell from 7,540 million to 7,472 million weighted average shares. These figures come from the fiscal 2023 Form 10-K, accession 0000950170-23-035122, filed July 27, 2023.
